rawCommits.subject: fix(agents): stack agent card role beneath the name
rawCommits.body:
The 3D profile card nameplate drew the role as a right-aligned pill
vertically centered on the name, which overlapped long agent names. Move
the name up onto its own top line and render the role on a left-aligned
line beneath it within the same nameplate strip.

rawCommits.subject: fix(org-tools): parse Brave news search results from the correct path
rawCommits.body:
The server-side trusted-integration executor (the live path for workspace
Brave search) shaped news results with `/{vertical}/results`, but Brave's
News API returns results at the top-level `results` array (envelope type
"news", no `news` wrapper) — so news searches found nothing and silently
returned empty. Web search nests under `web.results` and was correct.

Use a vertical-aware pointer: `/results` for news, `/{vertical}/results`
otherwise (web unchanged). Adds tests for both verticals (news had none).

Companion to the same fix in the secondary in-harness execution path.

rawCommits.subject: test(integrations): align Brave news mock with real top-level results shape
rawCommits.body: The Brave News API returns results at the top-level `results` array (envelope type `news`), not under a `news` wrapper. The mock encoded the old wrapper shape, so assert_brave_actions failed against the corrected parser. Mock now matches the real API and the parser.

rendered.title: Brave news search starts returning results again
rendered.intro: A small but high-impact day: workspace Brave news searches that had been silently coming back empty now return real headlines, backed by a corrected parser and a matching test fixture. The 3D agent profile card also got a layout fix so long agent names no longer collide with the role pill.

entries.title: Agent profile card nameplate stacks name and role
entries.summary: The 3D agent profile card stopped overlapping long names with the role pill by moving the role onto its own line beneath the name.

items.text: Reworked the agent profile card nameplate so the name sits on a top line and the role renders as a left-aligned pill underneath, eliminating the collision that occurred when long agent names ran into the previously right-aligned, vertically centered role pill.

Tightened nameplate typography for the new layout — name drops from 123px to 104px and the role pill shrinks to 48px text in a slimmer 72px pill — so both lines fit cleanly within the same strip in light and dark themes.

entries.title: Brave news search now reads results from the correct envelope
entries.summary: Workspace Brave news searches were silently returning empty because the server-side parser looked under the wrong JSON path. The trusted-integration executor now uses a vertical-aware pointer.

items.text: Fixed a silent-empty bug in workspace Brave search: the server-side trusted-integration executor was reading news results from `/news/results`, but Brave's News API returns them at the top-level `results` array. News queries now use `/results` while web queries continue to read from `web.results`.
Added regression tests covering both verticals — including the previously untested news path — so the correct pointer is locked in against future envelope changes.

entries.title: Brave provider mock realigned with the live news envelope
entries.summary: The integration provider mock was updated to mirror Brave's real top-level news response shape, restoring the assert_brave_actions end-to-end test.

items.text: Updated the Brave provider mock to emit news results at the top level with an `envelope type: "news"` payload, matching the real API and the corrected parser so the assert_brave_actions integration test passes again.

highlights: Brave news search no longer returns silently empty results
Agent profile card nameplate redesigned for long names
Regression tests added for both Brave web and news verticals
